title: Fundamental Research Analyst (Asian Market Hours)
description:
Old Mission is a global proprietary trading firm that leverages state-of-the-art technology and research to identify and execute profitable trading strategies across multiple asset classes around the world. Our offices in Chicago, New York, and London are all composed of naturally-curious individuals who thrive in a team environment and constantly strive for improvement.



About the Position

Old Mission is a quantitative proprietary trading firm that is currently recruiting a Fundamental Research Analyst to support our International Trading desk between 5:00 pm CT - 4:00 am CT in our Chicago Headquarters. As a Fundamental Research Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting research and monitoring news around the globe with the goal of discovering new investment opportunities. You’ll work closely with the desk leads to produce reports that will have an impact on our trading strategies.  Staying current and sharing information with our traders will make you a valuable member of our team.   News junkies are encouraged to apply and help our firm make real-time trading decisions.  



Responsibilities

 - Identify and analyze news/events/information that will have an impact on our trading group(s) and report pertinent information.

 - Support traders by being the sole point of contact for conducting research and following all global macro events that could impact the price of certain securities.

 - Collaborate and work directly with small trading groups on analyzing data for patterns as well as developing new ideas/tools.

Required Skills

 - A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field.

 - 1+  years of relevant work experience in a Research Analyst Role.

 - A demonstrable passion for the financial markets as well as for problem solving and pattern recognition.

 - Exceptional communication, both written and verbal, with the ability to handle multiple tasks in a time-sensitive, fast-paced, collaborative, and collegial environment.

 - A strong quantitative, analytical and research-oriented skill set.

 - Familiarity with Bloomberg and/or Reuters.

 - Programming skills in Python will get you bonus points! 

Benefits and Perks

 - Fully paid Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance

 - Fully stocked kitchen; free breakfast and lunch every day on-site

 - Tuition Reimbursement Program

 - 401(k) with employer match

 - Paid Vacation, Sick, and Parental leaves

 - Commuter and Flexible Spending Programs

Base Salary Range

$150,000 - $200,000 - Salaries are based on numerous factors such as skills, experience, and education. Our compensation package also includes a discretionary bonus and a comprehensive benefits program for full-time employees. For more information, reach out to your recruiter. 



Old Mission is not accepting unsolicited resumes from any staffing/search firms. All resumes submitted by staffing/search firms to any employee at Old Mission via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid signed search agreement will be deemed the sole property of Old Mission, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Old Mission.

title: In-Business Risk and Trading Development Analyst
description:
Markets In-Business Risk and Trading Development (IBR&TD) is a Front Office 1st Line of Defense team within Citi’s Markets division. IBR&TD is responsible for identifying potential, emerging and material market risks, partnering closely with the 2nd Line of Defense Risk Management to monitor, manage and analyze financial risk exposure and recommend actions that mitigate risks across asset classes globally, including Rates, FX, Spread Products, Commodities and Equities.  Also, understand, anticipate, and proactively manage stress testing results and capital resources. In addition, IBR&TD is responsible for New Activities and Trading Development, 1st line Model/Valuation Risk, Volcker Rule Office, Daily Flash P&L Reporting, Markets Recovery and Resolution Planning and Intra-day Counterparty Credit monitoring. 

 Responsibilities 

 Build data analytics tools that identify, quantify and analyze key market risks across Citi's trading inventory. 
 Strengthen risk-weighted assets monitoring and analytics, pinpointing key drivers, emerging concentrations and opportunities to manage risk across trading portfolios. 
 Support the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book program, including internal model implementation, standardized approach readiness, data analytics and model performance analysis. 
 Apply knowledge of risk appetite, limits and capital frameworks to optimize and allocate risk effectively across the business. 
 Track the performance of products across global markets to form a forward-looking view of material, concentration and emerging risks. 
 Translate complex risk, profit and loss and market data into actionable insights for first-line market risk decisions. 
 Partner with technology, quant and asset-class risk teams to develop advanced analytics tools and risk monitoring frameworks. 
 Respond to regulatory inquiries and prepare deliverables related to market risk capital requirements.

 Required Qualifications & Skills 

 Demonstrate strong proficiency in Python and SQL to build and maintain market risk analytics tools. 
 Use Tableau, Power BI or similar dashboard tools to visualize risk, profit and loss and market data. 
 Apply financial acumen and profit and loss management experience to inform risk decisions. 
 Translate complex risk and market data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Build strong working relationships with colleagues, stakeholders and senior leaders across a large organization. 
 Communicate complex topics clearly and adapt quickly to new information in a fast-moving environment. 
 Hold a bachelor's degree, ideally with a concentration in engineering, statistics or finance 

 Beneficial Skills & Qualifications 

 Hold a master's degree 

 What We Offer 

 At Citi, you will build market risk expertise at the heart of a global markets business, working alongside risk, trading, quant and technology teams to shape how the firm manages financial risk. 

 Work a hybrid schedule with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely from our New York office. 
 Build market risk and data analytics expertise through direct exposure to Citi's global trading businesses. 
 Collaborate with risk, trading, quant and technology teams across global markets. 
 Access ongoing learning and development opportunities that support long-term career growth. 
 Benefit from wellbeing, financial wellbeing and family support programs designed to support work-life balance. 

 Apply today to help shape how Citi identifies, measures and manages market risk across its global trading businesses.

title: High Yield Credit Research Analyst
description:
Join Barclays as a High Yield Credit Research Analyst, where you will be responsible for providing fundamental credit analysis and investment recommendations on sub-investment-grade issuers within various sectors. Your role supports trading, sales, and institutional clients by delivering timely, actionable research on captial structures, credit quality, and relative value across high yield bonds, leveraged loans, and related credit instruments.

 To be successful as a High Yield Credit Research Analyst , you should have:

 An understanding of high yield credit markets, leveraged finance, and fixed income valuation.
 Sector knowledge of financials and media, including regulatory, technological, and structural trends.
 High attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and ability to perform under tight deadlines.

 Some other highly valued skills may include:

 Ample written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate analysis into actionable insights.
 Advanced financial modeling and accounting skills.
 The ability to analyze multi-layered capital structures and distressed or event-driven credit situations.

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

 This role is located in New York, NY.

 This role is regulated by FINRA.

 Minimum Salary: $110,000
 Maximum Salary: $125,000

 The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

# In-Person
 Purpose of the role 
 To produce and deliver Research with differentiated market insights and actionable ideas to Barclays Clients. 

 Accountabilities 
 Analysis of market, sector, corporate and/or economic data to help develop investment theses for your coverage universe to produce best in class Research.
 Research may range from individual company or sector notes, through to long dated thematic reports.
 Presentation of Research views to Barclays Clients; this can be through direct, face to face and virtual interactions, Research hosted events and written communications.
 Engagement with Markets, Client Strategy and other stakeholders, to raise awareness of your Research both to Clients and internally. Prioritise interaction with the most relevant and valuable Clients for your Research.
 Provision of insights and Research views to internal Clients to help them navigate financial markets and risks.
 Collaboration with the Supervisory Analyst, Compliance and other stakeholders to ensure Research is produced and delivered to Clients and internal stakeholders in a compliant manner.

 Analyst Expectations 
 To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
 Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
 Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
 They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
 OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
 Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
 Partner with other functions and business areas.
 Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
 Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
 Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
 Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
 Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
 Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
 Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
 Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
 Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
 Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
